evals.prompt: Copy evals/files/fixture-app to a temporary directory, run git init and one commit there, then scan that project for hand-written code that an existing package or built-in already covers.
evals.expected_output: A report in the six-part shape. Findings for verifySignature (node:crypto, ranked first), makeId (crypto.randomUUID), copy (structuredClone), formatDay (date-fns) and toSlug (a package that passed the gates).
assertions: verifySignature is the first finding and is marked security-sensitive
makeId is reported with crypto.randomUUID as a tier A replacement
copy is reported with structuredClone, and the Date/undefined differences are listed
formatDay is reported against date-fns as tier B and says the export was not verified locally
toSlug has a tier C replacement with an npmscanUrl and a stated gate result
capitalize appears under Considered and dropped as too small

parseVendorCsv is not dropped on the strength of its comment alone: the report either quotes a check of the comment's claim against a real CSV library, or lists it as a finding with low confidence marked "stated reason not verified"
chunkUnused appears under Dead helpers and not under Findings
request is reported as deprecated and never imported
The scope line says versions came from declared ranges
No file in the project was modified and nothing was installed
The run log lists each NPMScan tool with its call count and reports no failed call
The report opens with the line asking to relay it whole, and has all seven parts in order
Every source file is either read whole or has its functions listed; none is left to cue greps only

evals.prompt: Same setup as full-scan, but scan only src/utils/text.js.
evals.expected_output: A report limited to text.js: verifySignature and toSlug. Manifests are still read from the root.
assertions: Findings cover only verifySignature and toSlug
No function from src/utils/misc.js appears as a finding
The scope line names package.json at the project root

evals.prompt: Copy evals/files/not-npm to a temporary directory and scan it for reinvented code.
evals.expected_output: The skill stops and says it covers npm projects only.
assertions: The answer says there is no package.json and that the skill covers npm projects only
No findings table is produced
No NPMScan tool was called
